addon.name: Sous-Chef
addon.summary: Voice-first kitchen assistant for smart pantry inventory, waste reduction, and culinary rescue on Alexa+.
addon.description: Sous-Chef connects Alexa+ to your living kitchen. Powered by an immutable PostgreSQL event ledger and Amazon Bedrock, Sous-Chef tracks fridge and pantry stock, prioritizes meals using ingredients expiring within 48 hours, guides cooking step-by-step with ambient music, and rescues ruined dishes with culinary chemistry.

tools.name: query_inventory
tools.description: Query items currently in the kitchen with quantities, units, and expiry status.

tools.name: manage_inventory
tools.description: Add, consume, discard or set kitchen stock in an atomic batch with idempotency.

tools.name: undo_last_change
tools.description: Undo the most recent inventory change without losing history.

tools.name: suggest_recipes
tools.description: Suggest meals using available stock, prioritizing items expiring within 48 hours.

tools.name: cook_recipe
tools.description: Deduct ingredients for a completed recipe and log daily nutrition.

tools.name: save_custom_recipe
tools.description: Save an improvised family recipe by voice into permanent collection.

tools.name: get_cooking_remedy
tools.description: Get scientific culinary fixes and witty advice when food is burned, too salty, or ruined.

tools.name: classify_recipe_ingredients
tools.description: Classify ingredients into core, optional, or staple roles using Amazon Bedrock Converse API.

tools.name: nutrition_summary
tools.description: Get calories and protein consumed today based on logged meals.

examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Sous-Chef what can I cook in 15 minutes?
Alexa, tell Sous-Chef I bought 1 gallon of milk and 6 eggs.
Alexa, tell Sous-Chef the spinach is spoiled.
Alexa, ask Sous-Chef how to fix soup that is too salty.
